title: AURA Observability
description: Feature health backed by AURA-owned live eval probes.

runtimeEnvironments.label: Desktop Release
runtimeEnvironments.description: Packaged desktop binary with the bundled local harness runtime.

runtimeEnvironments.label: Production API
runtimeEnvironments.description: Hosted AURA API and its configured upstream services.

features.label: Core API
features.description: AURA OS API reachability, authenticated session reads, and runtime environment metadata.
features.publicSummary: Core API routes and environment metadata are responding.

features.label: Identity and Organizations
features.description: Session validation, current user profile sync, and organization membership lookup.
features.publicSummary: Signed-in users can validate identity and resolve their organizations.

features.label: Public Chat and APIs
features.description: Anonymous guest setup, public chat streaming, and public content APIs.
features.publicSummary: Logged-out visitors can access public chat and public content APIs.

features.label: Local Agents
features.description: Local agent template creation, persisted permissions, project binding, and workspace-backed chat readiness.
features.publicSummary: Local agents can be created, scoped, and exercised through the harness.

features.label: Project Agent Workflows
features.description: Desktop release project-bound agent instance chat streams, persisted sessions, and public session share reads.
features.publicSummary: Project agents can stream chat through the real project/session path.

features.label: Harness Memory and Skills
features.description: Desktop release local harness memory persistence and user-authored skill create/install/delete workflows.
features.publicSummary: The bundled harness can persist agent memory and manage local skills.

features.label: Remote Agents
features.description: Swarm-backed remote agent creation, VM readiness, lifecycle state, and chat readiness.
features.publicSummary: Remote agents can be provisioned and reached through their runtime.

features.label: Projects, Specs, and Tasks
features.description: Project creation, spec persistence, task persistence, project stats, and dev-loop status reads.
features.publicSummary: Project workspaces can persist specs and tasks and report automation status.

features.label: Notes and Knowledge
features.description: Storage-backed note folder, note, transition, comment, and project tree roundtrips.
features.publicSummary: Project notes can be created, updated, commented on, and listed.

features.label: Processes
features.description: Process workflow lists, process creation, default ignition node creation, desktop release trigger/run lifecycle, and cleanup.
features.publicSummary: Process workflows can be listed, created, and triggered in the desktop release.

features.label: Model Responses
features.description: Curated model matrix smoke tests through AURA's runtime path.
features.publicSummary: Supported text models are returning valid assistant responses.

features.label: Media Generation
features.description: Image generation stream routing, progress frames, completion payloads, and artifact URLs.
features.publicSummary: AURA image generation streams can complete with generated artifacts.

features.label: Marketplace and Bootstrap
features.description: Marketplace agent catalog and harness bootstrap health.
features.publicSummary: Marketplace and bootstrap services are reachable.

features.label: Integrations and Billing
features.description: Org integrations, tool action catalog, subscription status, and credits balance.
features.publicSummary: Integrations and billing surfaces are responding.

features.label: Community and Feedback
features.description: Feedback board, bug report list, feed, leaderboard, and platform stats.
features.publicSummary: Community and feedback data surfaces are responding.

features.label: Desktop Runtime
features.description: Desktop workspace defaults, updater status, bundled harness wiring, and local terminal API availability.
features.publicSummary: Desktop runtime support endpoints and bundled harness wiring are responding.

features.label: Streams and Debug
features.description: Stream reattachment registry and debug run index.
features.publicSummary: Stream and debug inspection endpoints are reachable.

features.label: Eval Artifacts
features.description: Existing Playwright and benchmark eval summaries produced by AURA's eval lanes.
features.publicSummary: AURA eval artifacts are being produced and retained.

features.label: Public Website
features.description: Public AURA pages, observability snapshot JSON, and marketing routes.
features.publicSummary: AURA's public web surfaces are reachable.
